subject: Lorim
text: From outside Lorim, go south, west, north twice, west, chop the trees, go north four screens, then go east twice, south twice, west, south, and east twice to enter the Ice Cave.

evidence.quote:
From the outside of Lorim go south, west, north twice, west, (chop the
trees), and go north four screens. If you need some equipment, there is
an Item shop west one screen. Otherwise go east twice, south twice,
west, south, and east twice. Now go into the cave.

subject: Item shop
text: There is an Item shop located one screen west of the path four screens north of the chopped trees near Lorim.

evidence.quote:
If you need some equipment, there is
an Item shop west one screen.

subject: Ice Cave Floor 1 Switch Puzzle
text: On Floor 1, walk to the odd tile to step on it, then wait at the south wall for the snowman and push him north onto the odd tile.

evidence.quote:
* Floor 1 * Go north, walk counter-clockwise around the ice and go
north. Go walk to the odd tile and step on it. Go south to the wall and
wait for the snowman. Then push him north onto the odd tile.

subject: Ice Cave Floor 1
text: On Floor 1, go east, use the Flame Chain to go north, cross the ice with the Chain to go west, use a Key on the north door, go east twice, use another Key on the door, and proceed north up the stairs to Floor 2.

evidence.quote:
Go east,
use the Flame Chain and go north. Use the Chain to cross the ice and go
west. Use a Key on the north door and go north. Go east, east, use a
Key on the door, go north, and then walk up the stairs.

subject: Ice Cave Floor 2
text: On Floor 2, navigate the ice paths, break the north wall with a Mattock or Morning Star, and head north up the stairs to Floor 3.

evidence.quote:
* Floor 2 * Go north, west, and onto the ice. Once you are off the ice
walk around the rocks and get back onto the ice. Once you have stopped
sliding you should be in a room with stairs going down. Now take the
bottom left ice path south. Once you are off the ice, walk around the
rocks and back on the ice. Once you are off the ice go onto the single
path of ice in the middle, which will take you west. Once you are off
the ice use a Mattock/ Morning Star on the north wall. Then go north,
and up the stairs.

subject: Pond
text: On Floor 3, break the north wall with a Mattock or Morning Star to reach a pond that heals HP and MP.

evidence.quote:
* Floor 3 * Use a Mattock/Morning Star on the north wall. Go north to
the pond, which will heal your HP and MP.

subject: Ice Cave Floor 3 Treasure Chest
text: On Floor 3, defeating all enemies in the southern room reveals a treasure chest containing an Elixir.

evidence.quote:
Then go south to room full of enemies. Kill all of the
enemies and open the treasure for an Elixir.

subject: Ice Cave Floor 3
text: From the Elixir room on Floor 3, go north, east twice, use a Key on the door, and go north up the stairs to Floor 4.

evidence.quote:
Then go north, east, east,
and use a Key on the door. Then go north and up the stairs.

subject: Ice Cave Floor 4
text: On Floor 4, go east and step back into the cave to re-enter Floor 3.

evidence.quote: * Floor 4 * Go east and then go back into the cave.

subject: Lake
text: On Floor 3, unlocking the north door with a Key leads to a lake whose bottom restores HP and MP.

evidence.quote:
Then use a Key on the north door
and go through. Then walk to the bottom of the lake, which will restore
your HP and MP.

subject: Ice Cave Floor 3 Second Passage
text: Navigate across the ice tracks, use an Axe on the bramble, use a Key on the north door, break the west wall with a Mattock or Morning Star, and cross the streams using the Chain to reach the stairs to Floor 4.

evidence.quote:
* Floor 3 * Cross the ice using a Chain and go west twice. Then go
south and use the Chain to get to the middle. Step on the tile and go
on the northwest patch of ice. Then step on the odd tile in the
southeast corner. Then go south and east twice. (Use your axe to
destroy the bramble) Then step onto the east ice track. Once you are
off the ice step onto the ice to the south. Once you get off, use the
Chain to cross the ice and go west. Then use a Key on the north door
and go through. Then walk to the bottom of the lake, which will restore
your HP and MP. Then go onto the ice and west. You can use the Chain to
get off the ice. It is easier to get across using the post to the
north. Now use a Mattock/Morning Star on the west wall and go west
through the hole. Now use the Chain to go across the streams and then
go up the stairs.

subject: Ice Cave Floor 4 Second Visit
text: On Floor 4, go east and back into the cave to Floor 3, then go east, north, and up the stairs to Floor 4 boss area.

evidence.quote:
* Floor 4 * Go east, and walk back into the cave.

* Floor 3 * Now go east, north, and up the stairs.

subject: Kary
text: Kary moves horizontally across the screen at the top, middle, or bottom, so the best tactic is to stay above or below her, hit her head, and move opposite to her direction after she crosses the middle ice.

evidence.quote:
She moves horizontally in three
different spots, top/middle/bottom. The best tactic to use is to stay
either above or below her and hit her head. When Kary finishes moving
across the middle ice, make your move to the opposite direction of
where Kary is moving.

subject: Lich

evidence.quote:
Attacks:            Skulls
Best Equipment:     Morning Star, Cure Spell...The most damaging weapon that

subject: Lich
text: The Lich moves in a figure eight pattern and occasionally flies off-screen; standing in the middle with the Morning Star and alternating attacks with the Cure Spell allows striking him without taking damage if timed correctly.

evidence.quote:
Strategy: The Lich moves in a figure eight pattern. He will
occasionally deviate from the pattern, flying off the screen and
reappearing on the other side of the screen. He will then start the
figure eight pattern again. The best strategy is to have your Cure
spell equipped and have the Morning Star equipped. Just stand in the
middle of the screen and strike the Lich...If you hit
the Lich at the right time it will pass right over you without dealing
damage. If you do this properly the Hero won't take damage. Watch your
HP and just hit the Lich alternating with the Cure Spell until the Lich
dies.

subject: Kraken
text: The Kraken emerges from below and stabs with tentacles; stand directly above it stabbing down rapidly at its head, use your shield to block about 50% of blows, and watch out for damage from its explosion upon defeat.

evidence.quote:
Strategy: The Kraken comes from beneath you and uses its tentacles to
stab at your character. The best strategy is to stand directly above
the Kraken and stab down as fast as you can at the Kraken's head. The
shield will stop about 50% of the Kraken's tentacle blows. If you run
low on HP, use the Cure Spell. Also, the Kraken's explosion might
damage your character! Once the Kraken is defeated, a new entrance will
